name: project-overview-owner-parity
goal: Prove owner-only fleet status and fresh Project Overview data, item, decision, and run detail from the shared Mac and iOS fixture.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Tracker wttfb9 and the existing owner overview contract define machine freshness, scoped quota, projected detail and Hub access fences. Reuse publisher telemetry and shared native owner fixture.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Shared owner projection exposes current run details and bounded queue and provider telemetry. Hub drops expired and revoked publishers without widening access.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Before: overview projection assertions lacked queue and run metadata, Hub API omitted expiry/revocation states, and the paired renderer could not find Review decision. After: 131 focused units, 30 Hub browser cases, 17 shared renderer cases, 5 built Mac cases, and all 8 native iOS Overview assertions passed with one synthetic owner fixture. Inspected Mac, native iOS, and Hub captures.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
